name: EasyInsights
author: EasyInsights

sections.description:
The EasyInsights plugin lets you integrate the EasyInsights Pixel in minutes-no code, no hassle. Send real-time, session-level data straight to Meta, Google Ads, and other platforms. It’s the smarter way to track, optimize, and grow.

Why Install the EasyInsights Plugin?

🔁 Higher CAPI Match Rates
Achieve a 10% to 40% boost in match rates by enriching your conversion events with high-quality, first-party data—like emails, phone numbers, FB click IDs, and more. Better match rates = better attribution.

🕒 Never Lose Conversions to 7-Day Cookie Limits
Cookies expire. Your conversions shouldn’t. With server-side tracking, collect first-party data that lasts longer and recover lost conversions, boosting your retargeting power and ad revenue.

📈 Effortless GCLID Tracking
Auto-capture GCLIDs with zero manual setup. Send clean conversion signals to Google Ads for precise attribution and campaign optimization. Know what’s working, double down on it.

👥 Improved Lookalike Audiences
Feed Meta & Google your most accurate first-party data to create super-targeted lookalike audiences. Find customers just like your best ones and scale with confidence.

HOW TO GET STARTED WITH EasyInsights

One-click install, Optimize campaigns not just for clicks, but for actual revenue-driving actions, 🔒 100% data secure. goto [easyinsights.ai] for more details

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No, it runs lightweight tracking operations asynchronously.

NEED EXPERT SUPPORT?

💡 No dev support needed
🧩 Full server-to-server integration support
Offical support: [https://easyinsights.ai/]
sections.installation:
Automated Installation

⚙️ Quick & Easy Setup
🔌 One-click install via WordPress

Manual Alternatives

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin will start tracking user interactions automatically.
